 Netflix viewers are 'cancelling plans and staying up until 3am' to binge dark thriller
 A detective investigates the brutal murder of a man at the hands of a young mother.
 Share Article Share Article Facebook X LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Email Copy Link Link copied Add us as preferred source Comments By  Ketsuda Phoutinane , Content Editor 10:26, Sun, Nov 8, 2026 Updated: 10:29, Sun, Nov 8, 2026 
 Viewers say Jessica Biel is sensational as murderer Cora Tannetti (Image: USA/Netflix) We've all been there; flicking through Netflix, iPlayer and back again in the hopes of finding something you actually feel like watching. A new release could catch your eye, but sometimes all it takes is a personal recommendation to lead you to your next obsession.
 A dark show on Netflix is neither new nor very well known, but viewers are riveted by the "electrifying" crime drama . Fans have admitted cancelling plans, staying up until 3am, and wasting a summer's day inside to keep watching. The Sinner , the programme in question, follows a detective investigating the chilling murder of a man stabbed to death by a young mother. Originally a miniseries, the show was so successful it went on for three more years.

 What is The Sinner about?
 In the first series, Bill Pullman plays a detective who he tries to understand what led a young mum, Cora Tannetti (Jessica Biel), to snap and violently kill a stranger. The thriller holds a stellar 92% score on Rotten Tomatoes, with subsequent series ranging from 88% to 92%.
 The synopsis of The Sinner reads: "Detective Harry Ambrose investigates various atrocious murder cases and tries to analyse the reasons behind ordinary people committing heinous crimes.
 "He employs some unusual tactics and a deep capacity for empathy to solve his cases. His boundless dedication is driven by his dark past, leading him into powerful and often dangerously intimate bonds with his suspects."
 Article continues below ADVERTISEMENT The critics' consensus says: "The Sinner's first season, as a standalone, is as good as it gets. If you're looking for a murder mystery to sustain your dark impulses and drag you kicking and screaming from start to finish, look no further."
 Article continues below ADVERTISEMENT The series, which aired from 2017 to 2021, was adapted from the novel of the same name by Petra Hammesfahr. It became an anthology, with the detective investigating a different murder each series.
 What audiences say
 The Sinner came up in a Reddit thread when someone asked for something "impossible to pause". They said: "Which TV series had you saying 'just one more episode'... until it was suddenly 3am?
 "I’m looking for shows with that binge effect — the ones that hook you so hard, it’s impossible to stop at just one episode. I want twists, cliffhangers, intense pacing — anything that makes you lose all track of time.
 "Not necessarily the most famous or critically acclaimed, just the most impossible to pause. You know the kind. What are the shows that grabbed you by the throat and wouldn’t let go?!"
 Netflix is showing series so gripping viewers are binging it until nearly 2am 
 'I went to Russell Brand gig - what he said to my teen daughter left me horrified' 
 One person said: "Had plans to go out with a roommate. We started episode 1 at 8pm and next thing we knew it was 3am". To which another replied: "Literally the first show I thought of!"
 The sentiment was shared by a film critic: "After one episode, you'll happily want to skip the beach to stay home and watch the show you can't help but become obsessed with."
 An IMDB user declared: "This show is the BEST THRILLER to come out in a long time. "It's the type of show where you are always inside the screen. You are paying close attention to every little detail, you are trying to connect all the dots, you want to untangle the characters, get in their mind, solve the mystery and at last you will be asking 'WHY CORA TANNETTI DID THIS??'
 "The performances are top-notch; you can see inside the character through the actor. Jessica Biel really leads the show in an extraordinary manner.
 "The plot is amazing and [the] writing makes sure the show is always connected to the original content.
 "The mystery deepens with every episode and you will be left crying for the next one. DON'T MISS IT!!!"
 All four series of The Sinner are currently available to watch on Netflix UK. Subscriptions begin from £7.99 a month.
